about:
Delvie's Plastics Inc. is based in South Salt Lake, Utah. Founded over 60 years ago, the company began by selling acrylic sheet to local hobbyists, schools, artists, and small businesses. No founders are named in available sources, and ownership structure is not publicly disclosed.

The company supplies a wide range of acrylic products including transparent, translucent, pastel, fluorescent, glitter, and mirror cast acrylic sheets, as well as two-tone plastic, acrylic rods and tubes, and wall mounts and desk frames. It also offers custom laser cutting and UV printing services, allowing customers to provide designs or collaborate on new ones. A free product catalog is available for download.

Delvie's serves small businesses, educators, artists, and creators nationwide. Its materials are used for signage, wedding and event decor, party supplies, and general fabrication projects. The company's blog provides laser cutting settings and tips for major CO2 laser systems.

The company emphasizes its decades of experience and commitment to quality acrylic supplies with outstanding customer service as key differentiators.
